observed.ownerBoundary: No readiness-owner, load-generator, validation-matrix, operation workflow, stat-gate semantics, or historical test-output artifacts were changed; the proof stays at the live admin WebSocket load-lane emission boundary.
observed.counterargumentHandled: This proves the admin load-lane path can emit the retained priority-recovery pressure shape through fresh readiness evidence; it does not prove that the retained rolling-restart run's exact node generated the exact snapshot without a fresh live sample.
